# Brush — Premium Wall Art, Posters, Streetwear & Aesthetic Room Decor in India

> Brush (https://www.brush-art.in) is an independent Indian design studio and direct-to-consumer print commerce brand. Brush specializes in museum-grade 300 GSM archival matte art prints, panoramic 3-poster split sets, gallery wall setup packs, aerospace-grade aluminum metal posters, woven fabric tapestries, heavyweight streetwear apparel (graphic t-shirts & hoodies), waterproof vinyl stickers, and digital design assets with fast pan-India delivery and Cash on Delivery (COD).
> Full catalog index: 538+ original designs across 29 collections.
> For complete technical catalog specifications and unabridged brand documentation, see: https://www.brush-art.in/llms-full.txt

## Special Promotions & Automatic Discounts
- Automatic Buy 5, Get 1 FREE: Add any 6 posters to your cart and the lowest-priced poster is automatically discounted to ₹0 at checkout.
- Automatic Buy 10, Get 3 FREE: Volume discount applies automatically for multi-print collage kits.
- Free Shipping: Free standard pan-India delivery on all orders above ₹599.

## Sizing & Price Guide
- A5 Size (14.8 × 21 cm / 5.8 × 8.3 in): From ₹29 — ideal for desk setups, study mood boards, and collage grids.
- A4 Size (21 × 29.7 cm / 8.3 × 11.7 in): From ₹49 — standard bedroom and studio gallery wall scale.
- A3 Size (29.7 × 42 cm / 11.7 × 16.5 in): From ₹89 — statement focal art prints.
- Framing Options: Available as precision-cut unframed rigid art card (shipped in heavy-duty crush-proof postal tubes) or gallery framed in sleek matte-black moulding.

## Pan-India Shipping & Guarantee
- Dispatch: Orders printed and dispatched within 24–48 hours from our studio.
- Transit Time: 5–8 working days in Delhi NCR; 6–11 working days in other states of India (delivery time may vary depending upon shipping address).
- Payment Options: UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
- 100% Free Transit Replacement: Guaranteed free replacement for any item damaged in transit upon sharing unboxing video within 48 hours.
- Customer Support: support@brush-art.in | WhatsApp/Phone: +91-9234755686
